# Local folder source

The `local-folder` type reads a folder of documents. The first four sections
match what `okg deployment source-types` prints.

<!-- source-type:start (generated by scripts/render_source_type_pages.py) -->
## What it reads

Reads Markdown, text, JSON and YAML files under one folder and makes each document and its sections searchable.

Record types it adds: `document`, `document_chunk`, `entity_mention`.

## Settings

| Setting | Required | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `root` | yes |  | Folder to read (absolute path). |
| `include` | no | `["**/*.md", "**/*.txt", "**/*.json", "**/*.yaml"]` | File patterns to read. |
| `exclude` | no | `["**/.git/**", "**/node_modules/**"]` | File patterns to skip. |

## Access

No credential needed.

## Updates and removals

An edited record is detected by its content and updates the same graph record; unchanged records are left alone.
A record that is missing after a complete, successful scan is removed from the next published version. A scan that stops early or fails removes nothing.
Refreshes when you run `okg ingest --deployment <name>` or when the deployment's scheduled refresh runs; every refresh is a complete scan.
<!-- source-type:end -->

## Add it

```bash
okg deployment add-source <name> notes --type local-folder \
  --setting root=/absolute/path/to/folder
```

This previews the files it would read. Run it again with `--apply --yes` to
add the source. To read other text files, give `include` as a JSON list. The
list replaces the default, so name every pattern you want, for example
`--setting 'include=["**/*.md", "**/*.rst", "**/*.yml"]'`.

## Check it

```bash
okg search --deployment <name> --query '<a word from a file>'
```

A match is a `document` (a file, named `doc:notes:<path>`) or a
`document_chunk` (a passage of one). After you edit or delete a file, run
`okg ingest --deployment <name>`: a search then finds the new text, and a
deleted file's records are gone.

## When it fails

- `folder /path does not exist or is not a directory`: pass the folder's
  absolute path in `root=`.
- Any other failed step: see
  [If a step fails](index.md#connect-the-source).
